scope: synthetic proposal and ACP lifecycle only

prompts.followup: Keep the chosen duplicate policy and add a one-line docstring to the proposed function. Return the worker marker remembered from the first message and the updated function. Do not use tools or execute the code.

prompts.reload: Do not use tools. State the worker marker from the start of our conversation and the duplicate policy chosen by the coordinator.
